title: 第一章奇遇新生

content_zh:
盘古在混沌中修炼了无尽岁月，感觉已达到了顶峰，要想更进一步便得破开混沌，开天辟地，证得无上永恒。终于手持开天神斧的盘古，在混沌中现出盘古真身后，举起手中的开天神斧，简简单单的一斧劈出，混沌破碎，地水火风肆虐。时又有三千混沌魔神來相阻，因为他们生于混沌、悟道于混沌，而今混沌破碎，他们又该如何生存。然而盘古之强超乎想像，即使他们数量多但面对盘古也只有被斩杀的份。
没有了阻碍，盘古一斧又一斧的劈向混沌，直到七七四十九斧后，混沌之中的混沌之气开始划分清浊，清气上升，浊气下沉！渐渐的形成了天和地。顿时，整个混沌开始爆炸起来，混沌之气所化的气浪如水般的不停四散开来。随着第四十九道斧迹过后，开天神斧亦是无法承受下去，轰然爆炸开来，化为一图一钟一幡，正是那开天三宝太极图、混沌钟、盘古幡，三件至宝在道道霞光的笼罩下，落入盘古的手中，盘古左手持混沌钟、右手持盘古幡，脚踏太极图，周身玄光环绕，端是不凡。
正在这时本来上升的清气突然下沉，浊气也开始上升，天地似是承受不住混沌的压迫，欲要重归混沌。盘古见状连忙现出盘古真身，扔出开天斧化为太极图，盘古幡，混沌钟，随即双手高高的撑起，千万丈盘古真身顶天立地！太极图放出金桥定住大地分理阴阳，盘古幡划出道道万丈混沌剑气劈开混沌，混沌钟敲出阵阵大道之音定住地水火风。天地渐渐扩大，盘古亦随之増高，如此数百万年后，天地终于都变得非常牢固，稳定起来。但盘古却因为顶天立地力竭而亡，终因劳累不堪而累倒死去。
就在他临死之一瞬。他的全身却忽然发生了根本变化：他口里呼出的气，顿时变成了风和云；他呻吟之声，变成了隆隆作响的雷霆；他的左眼变成了太阳，右眼变成了月亮；手足和身躯，变成了大地和高山；血液变成江河；筋脉变成了道路，头发和胡须，也变成了天上的星星；皮肤和汗毛，变成了草地林木；肌肉变成了土地；牙齿和骨骼，变成了闪光的金属和坚石、珍宝；身上的汗水，也变成了雨露和甘霖。脊椎化为不周山。盘古元神一分为三结合先天清气化为后世三清，飞出十二滴精血结合浊气藏入不周山底，后化形为十二祖巫。这时天上降下大量先天功德和玄黄之气，形成一道贯穿天地的金色光柱和玄黄气柱。功德落下后，三清各得一成，十二祖巫共得三成，一成结合七成玄黄之气化为玄黄玲珑宝塔。两成结合三成玄黄之气化为鸿蒙量天尺，最后一成落向洪荒万物。
自此洪荒初成，万物新生，步入洪荒时代！天地初开，世界充斥着无尽的混沌灵气，从而世界还是一片苍茫，生灵万物在这样的环境下还无法生存，也许当混沌灵气大部分转化为先天灵气之时才会出世。洪荒大陆广袤无限，东西南北纵横不知多少亿亿公里，大地之广无边无际，更别说大地四周那比大陆广阔不知多少倍的海洋，海洋中漂浮着一座座大大小小的岛屿，或是盘古血肉所化，或是混沌神魔尸身所化，或是混沌残片演化；大地上无数高山耸立云中，洪荒山脉之高难以想象，最低的山也有数万丈高，最高的山为不周神山，盘古脊梁所化，有无限接近十亿丈的高度，为天之极数。
岁月流逝，距离开天已过去九个纪元（1会=10800年1元会=12会=129600年1纪元=3000元会=4亿年），洪荒中的混沌灵气已经差不多全部转化成先天灵气，万物开始苏醒。“我这是在哪，不是死了吗？”风洛从沉睡中醒来，突然发现了自己的异样。他发现自己已经没有了身体，只剩下一团轻飘飘的气体，不，用修行之人来说只剩下元神。
风洛是一名现代青年，作为一个宅男，除了吃饭睡觉，剩下的时间差不多就是在网上度过了。然而天有不测风云，在一个夏天，家人实在看不下他如此疲懒，果断把他赶出家门，美名其曰多出去走走，有益身心健康。于是无奈的他只好踏出家门了，炎炎夏日，风洛想起自己从没有去过海边，何不趁着时机去看看。因此风洛来了一次他人生中为数不多的旅行，也很悲剧地遇上了为数不多的一次海啸。再次醒来就变成了现在这个样子。面对如此陌生而且恐怖的情境，风洛只感到无限恐惧，而此时一道信息冲入识海，终于让他知道自己的处境了。自己竟然来到了开天之初的洪荒世界，这可是神话传说中的世界，是神仙妖魔共舞的时代啊！前世整天上网，网络小说自然没少看，对于这样的世界自然无限向往，期望自己能够修成大神通，飞天遁地、移山倒海无所不能。他时常幻想着如果真有下一世，希望能踏上修行路，御剑九天，纵横天地。朝闻道，夕死可矣的修道之路。

content_en:
Pangu practiced in the chaos for endless years, and felt that he had reached the peak. If he wanted to go further, he had to break through the chaos, open up the world, and achieve supreme eternity. Finally, Pangu, who was holding the Kaitian Divine Ax, appeared in the chaos. After Pangu's true form appeared, he raised the Kaitian Divine Ax in his hand and struck out with a simple axe. Chaos was shattered and earth, water, fire and wind raged. At that time, three thousand Chaos Demon Gods came to stop them, because they were born in Chaos and gained enlightenment from Chaos. Now that Chaos is broken, how can they survive. However, Pangu's power was beyond imagination. Even if they were in large numbers, they could only be killed when facing Pangu.
Without any obstacles, Pangu struck at the chaos with ax after axe. Until after seven or forty-nine axes, the energy of chaos in the chaos began to divide the clear and turbid air. The clear air rose and the turbid air sank! Gradually, heaven and earth were formed. Suddenly, the entire chaos began to explode, and the air waves formed by the energy of chaos spread out like water. After the forty-ninth ax trace passed, the Kaitian God Ax could not withstand it anymore and exploded suddenly, turning into a picture, a bell and a flag. It was the Kaitian Three Treasures Taichi Diagram, Chaos Bell, and Pangu Flag. Under the shroud of rays of light, the three treasures fell into Pangu's hands. Pangu held the Chaos Bell in his left hand, the Pangu Flag in his right hand, and stepped on the Taichi Diagram. He was surrounded by mysterious light all over his body, which was extraordinary.
At this moment, the clear air that was rising suddenly sank, and the turbid air began to rise. The heaven and earth seemed unable to withstand the oppression of chaos and wanted to return to chaos. Seeing this, Pangu quickly showed his true body, threw the sky-opening ax and turned it into a Tai Chi diagram, Pangu flag, and Chaos Bell. Then he raised his hands high, and Pangu's true body, which was thousands of feet tall, stood tall against the sky! The Tai Chi Diagram released a golden bridge to anchor the earth and divide the yin and yang. The Pangu flag drew out thousands of meters of chaotic sword energy to split the chaos. The chaos clock struck out bursts of great sounds to anchor the earth, water, fire and wind. The heaven and earth gradually expanded, and Pangu also increased accordingly. After millions of years, the heaven and earth finally became very solid and stable. But Pangu died of exhaustion because he stood upright, and finally collapsed and died of exhaustion.
Just before he died. But his whole body suddenly underwent fundamental changes: the breath he exhaled suddenly turned into wind and clouds; his moans turned into rumbling thunder; his left eye turned into the sun, and his right eye turned into the moon; his limbs and body turned into the earth and mountains; his blood turned into Rivers and veins turned into roads, hair and beards turned into stars in the sky; skin and fine hairs turned into grass and trees; muscles turned into land; teeth and bones turned into shining metals, solid stones and treasures; the sweat on the body turned into rain, dew and rain. The spine turns into Buzhou Mountain. Pangu Yuanshen was divided into three parts and combined with the innate clear energy to transform into the three pure states of later generations. He flew out twelve drops of essence and blood combined with the turbid energy and hid them at the bottom of Buzhou Mountain, and later transformed into the twelve ancestral witches. At this time, a large amount of innate merits and black and yellow energy descended from the sky, forming a golden pillar of light and black and yellow air that penetrated the heaven and earth. After the merit falls, each of the Three Pure Ones will get 10%, and the Twelve Ancestral Witches will get a total of 30%, and 10% will be combined with 70% of the Xuanhuang Qi to turn into a Xuanhuang exquisite pagoda. Twenty percent combined with thirty percent of the black and yellow energy turned into the Hongmeng Heavenly Ruler, and the last tenth percent fell towards all things in the wild.
Since the beginning of the prehistoric era, all things have been reborn and entered the prehistoric era! When the world first opened, the world was filled with endless chaotic spiritual energy, so the world was still vast. All living things could not survive in such an environment. Perhaps they would be born when most of the chaotic spiritual energy was transformed into innate spiritual energy. The prehistoric continent is vast and infinite, stretching from east to west, north and south for countless billions of kilometers. The vastness of the earth is boundless, not to mention the ocean surrounding the earth that is countless times wider than the continent. There are many large and small islands floating in the ocean, or islands. It is transformed from ancient flesh and blood, or it is transformed from the corpses of chaotic gods and demons, or it is evolved from the fragments of chaos; countless high mountains on the earth stand in the clouds, and the height of the prehistoric mountains is unimaginable. The lowest mountain is tens of thousands of feet high, and the highest mountain is Buzhou Mountain, the backbone of Pangu.Hua has a height infinitely close to one billion feet, which is the highest number in the sky.
The years have passed, and nine eras have passed since the creation of the sky (1 Hui = 10,800 years, 1 Yuan Hui = 12 Hui = 129,600 years, 1 era = 3,000 Yuan Hui = 400 million years). Almost all the chaotic spiritual energy in the prehistoric era has been transformed into innate spiritual energy, and all things have begun to wake up. "Where am I? Am I dead?" Feng Luo woke up from his deep sleep and suddenly noticed something strange about himself. He found that he had no body, only a ball of light gas, no, in the words of a practitioner, only the soul was left.
Feng Luo is a modern young man. As a homebody, apart from eating and sleeping, he almost spends the rest of his time online. However, something unexpected happened. One summer, his family couldn't stand how tired he was, so they kicked him out of the house, saying that walking more every day was good for his physical and mental health. So he had no choice but to step out of the house. In the hot summer, Feng Luo remembered that he had never been to the beach, so why not take advantage of the opportunity to go and have a look. So Feng Luo took one of the few trips in his life, and tragically encountered one of the few tsunamis. When I woke up again, it was like this. Facing such a strange and terrifying situation, Feng Luo only felt infinite fear. At this time, a piece of information rushed into the sea of ​​​​consciousness, finally letting him know his situation. He actually came to the ancient world at the beginning of the world. This was a world in myths and legends, an era where gods, immortals, and demons danced together! In my previous life, I spent all day surfing the Internet and read a lot of online novels. I naturally longed for such a world and hoped that I could develop great supernatural powers, fly into the sky, escape from the earth, move mountains and seas, and be omnipotent. He often imagined that if there was a next life, he hoped to embark on the path of spiritual practice, wield a sword for nine days, and control the world. Hear the Tao in the morning and die in the evening.
